_meta.pack: 雅伟之界 text pack (data/text/), deliverable 2 of 最终方案 §三
_meta.rule: 只用 data/text/，不要读 Sword-182/Words-182 的工作副本 / Read only data/text/, never the Words-182 or Sword-182 working copies.

excluded.leb: LEB: free to give away, but every quotation must carry its credit line and use is subject to reporting duties (docs/leb-licence-request.md). App-only reading; not redistributed in the globe.
excluded.net: NET (English): bundled in the app on the owner's relayed decision (2026-09-09), not a written publisher grant for redistribution. App-only.
excluded.cnet / cnet-tr: Chinese NET: permission recorded in the source index but no written notice on file. App-only.
excluded.csb: CSB: grant to Raymond Suen personally for one named work, gratis while free; already barred from images in Words (kVerseImageRestrictedVersions). App-only.
excluded.nasb: NASB: licence request unresolved (docs/nasb-licence-request.md); hidden in Words. Not used at all.
excluded.lxx: LXX (Greek): critical edition unnamed, licence unresolved (Peter to judge); barred from images in Words. Not used at all.
excluded.lzz / lzz-tr: 吕振中译本: oral permission only. Not used at all.
excluded.rst-s: Russian Synodal with Strong's (RusSynodalLIO / LiO / BJU): copyrighted, permission requested, dev-only branch. Not used.

bible/cuvs-yhwh-tr.json.name: 和合本雅偉版（繁體）/ CUV, Yahweh edition (Traditional)

bible/bsb-yhwh.json.name: Berean Standard Bible (Yahweh)
bible/bsb-yhwh.json.licence: Public domain (BSB since 2023-04-30); divine-name restoration by Yahweh De Hua Ministry
bible/bsb-yhwh.json.attribution: Public domain since 2023-04-30, no permission required for any use · the Yahweh edition's divine-name restoration is the work of Yahweh De Hua Ministry.
bible/bsb-yhwh.json.notes: 31,086 verses: the BSB omits 16 verses the KJV numbers (listed in versification-ru.json bsbOmits).

bible/asv-yhwh.json.name: American Standard Version 1901 (Yahweh)
bible/asv-yhwh.json.licence: Public domain (1901); divine-name restoration by Yahweh De Hua Ministry
bible/asv-yhwh.json.attribution: Public domain (1901) · the divine name is rendered Yahweh where the ASV printed Jehovah, an editorial restoration by Yahweh De Hua Ministry.

bible/web-yhwh.json.name: World English Bible (Yahweh)
bible/web-yhwh.json.attribution: Public domain. The World English Bible, with the divine name as Yahweh; supplied by Yahwehdehua (from eBible.org). The Apocrypha is not included.

bible/kjv.json.name: King James Version (1611 / 1769)
bible/kjv.json.notes: Prints LORD; shown as Yahweh by divine_name.py. (In the UK the KJV text is under Crown letters patent; Words records it as public domain.)

bible/jps.json.name: JPS 1917 (Tanakh)
bible/jps.json.attribution: Public domain. The Jewish Publication Society's 1917 translation, the divine name written YHWH; digital text from Open Siddur / JPS (CC0), supplied by Yahwehdehua. Old Testament only.

bible/brenton.json.name: Brenton's English Septuagint (1851)
bible/brenton.json.attribution: Public domain. Lancelot C. L. Brenton's English translation of the Septuagint (1851), from eBible.org, supplied by Yahwehdehua at this app's verse numbers. The Apocrypha and Psalm 151 are not included.
bible/brenton.json.notes: OT only (22,780 verses), at KJV verse numbers. This is Brenton's English, not the Greek LXX (excluded).

bible/rst.json.name: Синодальный перевод (1876) / Russian Synodal
bible/rst.json.attribution: Общественное достояние. / Public domain. Синодальный перевод (1876), digital text eBible.org (russyn).
bible/rst.json.notes: The plain public-domain Synodal from eBible.org, NOT the Strong's-tagged RusSynodalLIO (rst-s, licence pending, unmerged branch). Renumbered by Words to KJV numbering (tools/import_rst.py, CrossWire's Synodal->KJV rules); see versification-ru.json.

bible/wlc.json.name: Westminster Leningrad Codex (Hebrew OT)
bible/wlc.json.notes: Text only. Words' lemma/morphology layer (Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible, CC BY 4.0) is NOT in this pack. 23,142 verses at KJV ids.

bible/wh.json.name: Westcott-Hort Greek NT (1881)
bible/wh.json.attribution: Public domain. Westcott & Hort, The New Testament in the Original Greek (1881).
bible/wh.json.notes: The editors' single and double brackets for doubtful text are in the file; display_text removes the bracket characters.

bible/sblgnt.json.name: SBL Greek New Testament (2010)
bible/sblgnt.json.attribution: The Greek New Testament: SBL Edition (SBLGNT), edited by Michael W. Holmes. Copyright © 2010 Society of Biblical Literature and Logos Bible Software. Licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), provided as-is without warranties; source: https://sblgnt.com/license/. Changes: supplied via Yahwehdehua with paragraph and apparatus anchors already removed upstream; Words keeps the 6,901 apparatus notes as <note:> markup; this pack's display_text() removes them and the bracket marks. No wording edits.
bible/sblgnt.json.notes: CC BY 4.0 requires, wherever the text is shown or shared: the creators, the copyright notice, a link to the licence, the no-warranty notice, a link to the source, and a statement of changes. Use the attribution string verbatim (README §SBLGNT).

section_titles.json.name: Section titles and context notes (4 sets: cuv, cuv-tr, english-classic, ru)
section_titles.json.licence: BSB headings (public domain) + text written for the Words app
section_titles.json.notes: Section headings. Sections start where the 和合本 starts them. Titles are the Berean Standard Bible's headings (public domain), with the Chinese written for this app; where the BSB has no heading, the 和合本's own title, with English written for this app. Not taken from the NASB. Background notes ("context") are written separately and may be absent.
